data.name: Pankaj
data.gender_notes: Pankaj is used as a male name in Hindu naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: Pankaj means 'jewel' or 'precious one'. In Hindu mythology, this name is associated with Lord Shiva, who is known as the 'Adornment of the Universe'. The name Pankaj carries the meaning “Jewel, precious one” and is chosen by families in Hindu traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Sanskrit tradition and is also used in Hindi, Sanskrit, Marathi. Parents who choose Pankaj usually hope their child will grow to embody jewel, precious one and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.spiritual_meaning: Embodying the divine qualities of beauty, strength, and preciousness.
data.etymology: Pankaj belongs to the Sanskrit linguistic tradition and is used in Hindu naming. Its recorded meaning is “Jewel, precious one.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Pankaj total 8, giving a life-path number of 8. Number 8 is linked with Saturn and with the qualities of ambition, resilience and material success.

data.cultural_impact: The name Pankaj holds great significance in Hindu culture as it is associated with being a precious jewel or valuable possession. In ancient India, jewels were considered symbols of wealth, power, and prestige. Naming a child Pankaj was a way of expressing the parent's high regard for their offspring, acknowledging their inherent value and worth.
data.spiritual_significance: In Hinduism, Lord Shiva is a supreme deity known as the 'Adornment of the Universe'or 'Rajjarajeshwara'. The name Pankaj spiritually represents an individual who embodies the essence of Lord Shiva, being a source of spiritual wealth, power, and prestige. It is a reminder to the bearer of the name to strive towards self-improvement, inner beautification, and to be a precious adornment to humanity.
data.spiritual_symbolism: Pankaj, meaning 'lotus flower that has just bloomed', symbolizes new beginnings, purity, and the blossoming of inner beauty and wisdom. It is a name that inspires growth and self-realization.
